<thought>The mass spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1 Da and relative intensities matching the binomial distribution for many carbons. No 2 Da spacing or ~1:1 ratios characteristic of Cl, Br, or S are present, and the minor isotopes of N, O, etc., are too low to be distinguished. Thus only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
